# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user. 

# Software requirements


# Read in again
```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_T_07.rds")
```


## Overview of colData entries

### broad cell phenotyping
cluster_category - "Non-Epithelial" "Mixed" "Epithelial"
analysis_cat - "non_tumor" "tumor"
astir_combined
GMM_combined

### immune phenotyping
cluster_selected - SOM clusters
immune_metacluster - final metaclustering
astir_immune_combined
GMM_immune_combined

### Tcell phenotyping
Tcell_assignment - "CD4_T_cell" "CD8_T_cell" "double_positive"
Tcell_metacluster
Tcell_metacluster_combined
Tcell_fine_cluster
Tcell_district
Tcell_district_names
GMM_Tcell_combined
astir_Tcell_combined

### Patient Groups
Tex_patient

### Scores
PDL1_score
PDL1_score_cells
DP_score

# 1. Data integration

Load Data
```{r}
# Entire sce
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_04_ccRCC.rds")
# sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_T_07.rds")

# sce from subclassification into immune and stromal cells
sce_TME <-  readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")

# sce from T cell subset
sce_Tcell <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_06_ccRCC_Tcell.rds")
```


Remove two low quality images
```{r}
# Detected and removed in 06_Tcell_classification

sce <- sce[, sce$sample_id != "ZTMA20.1_Block3_SE_085"] # a lot of unspecific binding from different markers
sce <- sce[, sce$sample_id != "ZTMA224.1_BlockB_SE_129"] # cropped

sce_TME <- sce_TME[, sce_TME$sample_id != "ZTMA20.1_Block3_SE_085"] # a lot of unspecific binding from different markers
sce_TME <- sce_TME[, sce_TME$sample_id != "ZTMA224.1_BlockB_SE_129"] # cropped
```


## Define which columns to transfer
```{r}
colnames(colData(sce_TME))[!colnames(colData(sce_TME)) %in% colnames(colData(sce))]
# To transfer: "GMM_immune_combined", "astir_immune_combined", "cluster_selected", "immune_metacluster"

colnames(colData(sce_Tcell))[!colnames(colData(sce_Tcell)) %in% colnames(colData(sce_TME))]
# To transfer: (all) "GMM_Tcell_combined", "astir_Tcell_combined", "Tcell_assignment", "Tcell_metacluster", "Tcell_fine_cluster", "Tcell_metacluster_combined", DP_score, Tcell_community_neighborhood, "Tcell_community", "Tcell_district", "Tcell_district_names, "Tex_Tcell_fra", "Tex_patient
```

## Transfer Information to "old" sce
```{r}
## 1. Cell type information
### 1. TME information
TME_info <- colData(sce_TME) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(immune_cluster_selected = paste0("immune_",sce_TME$cluster_selected)) %>% dplyr::select(cell_id, astir_immune_combined, GMM_immune_combined, immune_cluster_selected, immune_metacluster)


### 2. T cell information
Tcell_info <- colData(sce_Tcell) %>% as.data.frame %>% mutate(Tcell_district = paste0("T",sce_Tcell$Tcell_district)) %>% dplyr::select(cell_id, GMM_Tcell_combined, astir_Tcell_combined, Tcell_assignment,Tcell_metacluster, Tcell_metacluster_combined, Tcell_fine_cluster, DP_score, Tcell_community_neighborhood, Tcell_community, Tcell_district, Tcell_district_names, Tex_Tcell_fra, Tex_patient)


### Add to sce
sce$astir_immune_combined <- TME_info$astir_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$GMM_immune_combined <- TME_info$GMM_immune_combined[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_cluster_selected <- TME_info$immune_cluster_selected[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]
sce$immune_metacluster <- TME_info$immune_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, TME_info$cell_id)]

sce$GMM_Tcell_combined <- Tcell_info$GMM_Tcell_combined[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$astir_Tcell_combined <- Tcell_info$astir_Tcell_combined[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_assignment <- Tcell_info$Tcell_assignment[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_metacluster <- Tcell_info$Tcell_metacluster[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_metacluster_combined <- Tcell_info$Tcell_metacluster_combined[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_fine_cluster <- Tcell_info$Tcell_fine_cluster[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_district <- Tcell_info$Tcell_district[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_district_names <- Tcell_info$Tcell_district_names[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_community <- Tcell_info$Tcell_community[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tcell_community_neighborhood <- Tcell_info$Tcell_community_neighborhood[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tex_Tcell_fra <- Tcell_info$Tex_Tcell_fra[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$Tex_patient <- Tcell_info$Tex_patient[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]
sce$DP_score <- Tcell_info$DP_score[match(sce$cell_id, Tcell_info$cell_id)]

## 2. Color mapping
### TME
metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$immune_metacluster
metadata(sce)$colors$astir_immune_col <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$astir_col
metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_immune_col <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$GMM_col
metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$ISUP_combined 
metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined <- metadata(sce_TME)$colors$pT_combined

# names(metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster) <- paste0("MY_", names(metadata(sce)$colors$myeloid_metacluster))

### Tcell
metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_metacluster <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$Tcell_metacluster
metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_metacluster_combined<- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$Tcell_metacluster_combined
metadata(sce)$colors$astir_Tcell_col <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$astir_Tcell_col
metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_Tcell_com <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$GMM_Tcell_com
metadata(sce)$colors$CD8_metacluster <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$CD8_metacluster
metadata(sce)$colors$CD4_metacluster <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$CD4_metacluster
metadata(sce)$colors$immunen_metacluster_DP <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$immunen_metacluster_DP
metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_district <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$Tcell_district
metadata(sce)$colors$Tcell_district_names <- metadata(sce_Tcell)$colors$Tcell_district_names

## 3. Cluster channels
### TME
rowData(sce)$immune_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_TME)$used_for_clustering

### Tcell
rowData(sce)$CD8_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_Tcell)$CD8_cluster
rowData(sce)$CD4_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_Tcell)$CD4_cluster
rowData(sce)$Tcell_cluster_channel <- rowData(sce_Tcell)$Tcell_cluster # CD8_cluster and CD4_cluster channel combined
rowData(sce)$Tcell_markers_channel <- rowData(sce_Tcell)$Tcell_markers # all T cell markers (without 4-1BB)
```

## Combined Cell Type
```{r}
## Create combined cell type category
sce$celltype_combined_broad <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$Tcell_metacluster), sce$Tcell_metacluster,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$analysis_cat)) ## chnage!!

sce$celltype_combined <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$Tcell_metacluster), sce$Tcell_metacluster,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$analysis_cat))

sce$celltype_combined_fine <- ifelse(!is.na(sce$Tcell_fine_cluster), sce$Tcell_fine_cluster,
       ifelse(!is.na(sce$immune_metacluster), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$analysis_cat))

unique(sce$celltype_combined)
unique(sce$celltype_combined_fine)

colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(ISUP) %>%
  summarise(
    unique_pid_count = n_distinct(PID),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total_unique_pid = sum(unique_pid_count),  # Calculate total
    percentage = (unique_pid_count / total_unique_pid) * 100  # Calculate percentage
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage))
```
